products.name: D-Line Mini Raceway Cord Cover (1.18 in x 0.59 in, self-adhesive)
products.query: D-Line cord cover self adhesive wire hider paintable
products.summary: A half-round, paintable raceway with a click-lock lid and self-adhesive backing that sits above the baseboard and on vertical drops, so a lamp or TV cord is enclosed instead of dangling within reach.
products.renterNote: For renters with a few cords running up or along a wall in a nursery or living room. Caveat: the adhesive bonds strongly, and D-Line says removal takes a wall-paper scraper and adhesive remover, so test a hidden spot and plan the move-out cleanup.
pros: No drilling: self-adhesive backing, click-lock lid
Fits cords on baseboard runs, vertical drops and ceiling runs
cons: Adhesive is strong and needs remover on removal, so wall or paint damage is possible
Wall raceway only; it does not protect cords crossing open floor

specs.profile: 1.18 in W x 0.59 in H half-round
specs.install: self-adhesive backing, click-lock lid, flexible hinge
specs.accessories: bends, T, connector and end caps sold for the range
specs.removal: D-Line advises a wall-paper scraper and adhesive remover (Amazon safety note for the 157 in kit)

products.scoreNote: Tool-free peel-and-stick install, but the maker itself warns the bond is strong and needs adhesive remover, so reversibility is only mid-range.
products.serpEvidence: type-level only: wall/floor cord covers or concealers recommended by babyproofme.com, lifesupplyusa.com, mistersparky.com, barnettelectrical.com, myfivestarhomeservices.com; D-Line is not named by any of them

products.name: Safety 1st Outlet Cover with Cord Shortener (Item 48308)
products.query: Safety 1st outlet cover with cord shortener
products.badge: Best for a plugged-in lamp or monitor
products.summary: A box-style outlet cover that encloses the plug in a used outlet and has a built-in cord shortener, so excess cord is stored inside and a toddler cannot pull the plug out.
products.renterNote: For renters whose nursery lamp, monitor or charger sits in a wall outlet at crawling height. Caveat: I could not confirm from maker or retailer text how it attaches to the outlet, so check the package before assuming it is fully tool-free and removable.
pros: Built-in cord shortener to avoid cord entanglement
Listed by Home Depot as UL-listed
cons: Stores roughly four feet of cord depending on thickness, so very long cords still need another fix
Covers one outlet only; power strips need a separate cover

specs.cordStorage: up to 4 ft of cord depending on thickness (Target listing)

products.scoreNote: Scores assume a no-drill plug-over fit that I could not verify; the dual-press release and built-in shortener are sourced, but the attachment method is not stated in the text I read.
